events.title: Inaugural Thanksgiving Mass & Jubilee Blessing
events.venue: St. Mary's Main School Grounds & Chapel
events.description: Solemn Holy Eucharistic celebration of thanksgiving presided over by Archbishop of Cuttack-Bhubaneswar, blessing the Golden Jubilee memorial pillar and hoisting the Jubilee Flag.

events.title: Grand Alumni Global Homecoming & Nostalgia Gala
events.description: A historic reunion for alumni spanning batches 1976 through 2025. Featuring batch roll-calls, felicitation of retired teachers, campus memory walks, and an evening cultural musical night.

events.title: Golden Jubilee Inter-School Cultural & Drama Fest
events.description: An elite inter-school cultural competition showcasing classical Odissi dance, western band performances, theatrical drama, and elocution on the theme "Service Through Excellence".

events.title: Golden Jubilee Track & Field Sports Olympiad
events.description: March past by past and present house captains (Red, Blue, Green, Gold), athletic track events, tug-of-war between Alumni and Staff, and medal presentation ceremonies.

events.title: Valedictory Grand Gala & Jubilee Souvenir Release
events.description: Grand finale of the 50-year celebration with release of "Golden Pages: 50 Years of Marian Heritage" commemorative souvenir, grand laser fireworks display, and jubilee banquet.
events.chiefGuest: Honorable State Education Dignitaries & Principal Sr. Mary Lina DungDung

timeline.title: Foundation of St. Mary's School
timeline.description: Established under the visionary patronage of Cuttack Roman Catholic Diocesan Corporation (CRCDC) Archdiocese of Cuttack-Bhubaneswar to bring quality English medium education to Jajpur Road.

timeline.title: Stewardship of the Sisters of Handmaids of Mary
timeline.description: The Sisters joined the mission, instilling disciplined values, compassion, moral stewardship, and establishing our motto: "Service Through Excellence".

timeline.title: Affiliation with CISCE / ICSE New Delhi
timeline.description: The school gained formal affiliation with the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE). The pioneer batch produced outstanding state ranks.

timeline.title: Inauguration of Modern Science Complex
timeline.description: Dedicated Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratories inaugurated alongside a state-of-the-art computer education facility.

timeline.title: Silver Jubilee Celebration (25 Years)
timeline.description: Celebrated a quarter-century of educational brilliance with the construction of the Silver Jubilee Academic Block and the first grand Alumni meet.

timeline.title: Auditorium & Multipurpose Sports Ground
timeline.description: Inauguration of Father Marian Multipurpose Auditorium, standard basketball and volleyball courts, expanding cultural and physical training programs.

timeline.title: Smart Digital Classrooms & STEM Labs
timeline.description: Transformation into interactive smart classrooms equipped with multimedia visual aids, digital coding labs, and enriched library archives.

timeline.title: Eco-Green Campus & Golden Jubilee Project Initiation
timeline.description: Installation of rooftop solar infrastructure, rainwater harvesting, and rollout of the Golden Jubilee Multipurpose Student Centre project.

timeline.title: The Golden Jubilee: 50 Glorious Years of Excellence
timeline.description: Half a century of nurturing leaders, doctors, engineers, educators, civil servants, and honest citizens. Proudly celebrating 1976 – 2026!

contributions.message: Congratulations St. Mary's on 50 glorious years of excellence!
Heartiest congratulations to St. Mary's on 50 glorious years! Forever proud to be a Marian.
To the teachers who shaped our lives with endless patience and devotion. Love you St. Mary's!
Blessed to have our children study in this sanctified temple of knowledge.
May Mother Mary shower endless blessings on St. Mary's School, Jajpur Road.

wishes.name: Amitav Senapati
wishes.message: From morning assembly hymns to the annual sports day march past, every memory of St. Mary's brings tears of joy. Happy 50th Golden Jubilee!

wishes.name: Sister Mary Rose (Former Staff)
wishes.message: Praying for the glorious continuation of Service Through Excellence. God bless our dear students and revered Principal Sr. Mary Lina DungDung.

wishes.name: Priyanka Routray
wishes.message: Can't wait for the Alumni Reunion in December! Meeting classmates after 11 years on our beloved campus is going to be unforgettable!
